description: This file contains helper functions for managing connection references and invoking connection handlers in Redis, including functions to increment/decrement references, check references, and call handlers with proper reference management.

methods.name: connIncrRefs
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a connection to ensure it remains valid during operations.

methods.name: connDecrRefs
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a connection, indicating it is no longer in use.

methods.name: connHasRefs
methods.description: Checks if a connection has active references.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Safely calls a connection handler by managing reference counts and closing the connection if scheduled for close.
